figurative_meaning_en: The most beloved child or darling offspring
example_sentences_in_bangla: আমার নয়নমণি আজ স্কুল থেকে ফিরলো।
তোমার নয়নমণিকে দেখলে মন ভরে যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: My apple of the eye returned from school today.
Seeing your darling child fills the heart with joy.
history: This idiom appears in traditional Bengali folk songs and literature, evoking deep familial bonds.
note: Often used in poetic and affectionate contexts in Bengali culture.
